answer: The Lahore Heights Apartments provide prayer mats, and the Qibla direction is indicated by an arrow sticker on the bedroom wardrobe. The Qibla direction is also marked on the apartment doors. The dawn (Fajr) call can be heard faintly in the early morning. Earplugs are in the bedside drawer.
guest_message: Do you provide prayer mats, and which direction is the Qibla?
evidence:
[{"source_id":"10.4","title":"Prayer facilities","text":"House manual > 10. Building Amenities and Accessibility > 10.4 Prayer facilities

Every apartment has prayer mats and a copy of the Quran. The Qibla direction is shown by an arrow sticker on the bedroom wardrobe. A neighbourhood mosque (Masjid Al-Noor, about 300 metres away) broadcasts the call to prayer five times a day, and the dawn (Fajr) call can be heard faintly in the early morning. All kitchens in the building are used for halal cooking only. Please do not bring pork products or alcohol into the apartments (section 11.3). - **Ground floor:** lobby and front desk, shared laundry room, the ramp from Gate 2, and the lifts.
- **Basement (B1):** parking, reached by the vehicle ramp from Gate 1 or by lift (press B1).
- **Each residential floor:** two lifts, Stair A and Stair B (fire exits), a trash room at the end of the corridor, and the apartment doors.
- **Roof level (R):** the shared roof terrace with the smoking corner at its north end, reached by lift or by Stair A.
- **Outside:** the front lawn at Gate 1 is the fire assembly point."},{"source_id":"10.2","title":"Roof terrace","text":"House manual > 10. Building Amenities and Accessibility > 10.2 Roof terrace

The shared roof terrace has seating and city views. It is open **7:00 AM to 10:00 PM**. It is a quiet space: no loud music, no gatherings, no parties and no barbecues. The only place in the building where smoking is allowed is the marked smoking corner at the north end of the roof terrace (section 11.2)."}]
